Common options include `format=`. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [DataFrame]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : A one-row model-level summary. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Glance at a fitted Cox model for its overall fit statistics: ::: {#d2003faa .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import greenwood as gw # Load data and fit a Cox model lung = gw.load_dataset("lung", backend="polars") cox = gw.CoxPH().fit("Surv(time, status) ~ age + sex", data=lung) # Glance at overall model-fit statistics gw.glance(cox, format="polars") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ```{=html}
